verdict.rationale: Secureframe offers an API to connect/read/create custom resources and an MCP server exposing controls, tests, vendors, frameworks, and risks as tools, indicating meaningful programmatic access. However, there's no evidence the API/MCP surface covers the full breadth of UI functionality (e.g., Trust Center customization, policy editor AI features, user access review workflows, risk assessment automation) — missing for 10: documented API parity across all UI features, evidence of write/workflow actions (approvals, reviews, policy generation) via API, and independent confirmation of completeness.
